name: schematic
description: Schematic — agent-native virtual hardware workbench (WebMCP hackathon)

scripts.build: pnpm run build:workspace && npm --prefix chatgpt-site run build
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:workspace && npm --prefix chatgpt-site run lint
scripts.test: pnpm run test:workspace && npm --prefix chatgpt-site run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:workspace && npm --prefix chatgpt-site run typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck:workspace && pnpm run lint:workspace && pnpm run test:workspace && pnpm run build:workspace && npm --prefix chatgpt-site run verify
scripts.dev:backend: SCHEMATIC_DEPLOYMENT_ENV=local SCHEMATIC_AUTH_MODE=development python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001 --app-dir backend
